topic: Avoiding a fare on public transport can be justified

initialOpinions.text: Paying the fare is expected.  I cannot think of a reason that not paying is justified.

For me, this depends on how expensive the fare is and how well-maintained the service is. For example, I absolutely agree with turnstile jumping on the New York MTA subway, as they charge ridiculous fees and don't do a good job with upkeep.
I think if you ride knowing there is a fare, you should pay the fare. you cant justify stealing regardless of how you steal. it is wrong to justify anything that is theft

I think it is only fair that if all people are subject to the fee, everyone should have to pay. I believe some accommodations can be provided to individuals who demonstrate financial n, such as a discounted ride.
I think it's wrong - everyone has to pay or it's stealing,.

Avoiding a fare on public transport is not justified. The system relies on everyone paying their share to function. Fare evasion puts a heavier financial burden on other paying riders and can lead to service cuts.
I feel that the only time that is justified would be in an emergency. Suppose you are fearful of your safety? That would be a good reason not to pay.
There must be incomes to pay the drivers. Also, there much be money for fuel and transport maintenance
